test_title: PYST 39: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f267248b9931d7f4962f8c739718babc01fab4938790deb1ff9ba2437a04fed.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +8, -7.

Let’s check each option:

1. HD – PW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/977dcff47f9e20336cf05c5af217e4ac14887259faf3bb78faaa9814dc24c12e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +8, -7.

2. BX – IQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce9c969914929ac940e72a60d75fd539c925ac45c5ac57eca936f71c953f9652.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +8, -7.

3. QM – YF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a97d246f04915148b3a35de3240cb40f3fc05f8ffa5c51d62992b9f39863d695.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +8, -7.

4. CY – KR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2fc583e249bb044c5111200576f64c66d5197f55b3cdf005513f3e8bb5e08fa.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +8, -7.

Thus, BX – IQ is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
